title: Buy 2kg of Coffee Beans (Min Spend $76) and Get 1kg PNG Mountain Paradise Free & Free Delivery @ Crave Coffee
body:
Deal: Buy 2kg of Coffee Beans (Min Spend $76) and Get 1kg PNG Mountain Paradise Free & Free Delivery @ Crave Coffee

[huntabargain] Are you sure, 3kg for $76-$80 delivered?
[beefsandwich] Couldn't get this to work. 3x Mountain Paradise, no deal. 2 other coffee + 1 Mountain Paradise, no deal. Coupon invalid.
[alvian] It did not work because Crave Coffee & OP did not use plain text for the coupon code but the Unicode characters
𝗕 U+1D5D5 MATHEMATICAL SANS-SERIF BOLD CAPITAL B
𝗕 U+1D5D5 MATHEMATICAL SANS-SERIF BOLD CAPITAL B
𝟮 U+1D7EE MATHEMATICAL SANS-SERIF BOLD DIGIT TWO
𝟱 U+1D7F1 MATHEMATICAL SANS-SERIF BOLD DIGIT FIVE
The checkout expected the plain text BB25 code and not this cute but useless 𝗕𝗕𝟮𝟱 code.
[huntabargain] Is PNG Mountain Paradise good for cappuccino? Which 2kg best for cappuccino, Cafe KA blend?
[noise36] Good price per kg for what I assume is freshly roasted coffee but it is only fresh for 2-3 weeks so why would you buy such large amounts at once?
I used to buy 1kg at a time but drinking one coffee day it always went stale towards the end of the bag so now only buy 500g at a time.
[huntabargain] You can freeze each ~150gm in airtight container, stay fresh. I use old jam jars.
[heretisj] What are the roast levels for each bean type ?
[ThatsCheap] Are these freshly roasted and shipped out with the roast date clearly printed on the bag? If you've ordered from them before, could you please confirm?
Do the bags feature a one-way air valve and a resealable zipper? Or will I need to transfer the beans into an airtight container once opened?
